review: Solemn Lament Yi Sang brings a constant source of Butterfly to the table of a Sinking Team while boasting a relatively high damage output himself. His unique Ammo, known as "The Living & The Departed" (distinct from Butterfly), where ammo is divided into Potency (The Living) and Count (The Departed), with their combined total maxing out at 20. Whether Potency or Count is consumed would be randomly determined. Some attacks would fully cancel if both ammos run out, leading to an immediate reload. During the reload process, Yi Sang consumes SP, based on the current amount of The Living + The Departed (Ammo) you have, subtracted by 30, and then divided by 2. When gaining ammo back, you will either get The Living or The Departed based on ID’s current SP. If SP ≥ 0, 30% chance to gain The Living and a 70% chance to gain The Departed and vice-versa, if SP < 0. Probability is calculated separate
